entities.name: Request type
entities.description: Information element that indicates the type of request being made by the UE.

entities.name: PDU session ID
entities.description: Information element that identifies a specific PDU session.

entities.name: Payload container
entities.description: Information element that contains other NAS messages or information elements.

entities.name: PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST
entities.description: NAS message used to request establishment of a PDU session.

entities.name: PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REQUEST
entities.description: NAS message used to request modification of a PDU session.

entities.name: PDU session ID IE is included
entities.description: Condition that the PDU session ID information element is present in the message.

entities.name: Payload container contains PDU session establishment or modification request
entities.description: Condition that the payload container contains either a PDU session establishment request or a PDU session modification request that is not for 3GPP PS data off status change.

relations.description: The presence of PDU session ID IE guards the inclusion of Request type IE.
The payload container content condition guards the inclusion of Request type IE.
Payload container IE can contain PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message.
Payload container IE can contain PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REQUEST message.
